subject.title: feat: MCP Apps (ui://) Phase 0 — generic host in Control UI + plugin-declared MCP servers

question: Should native OpenClaw plugin manifests gain the public `mcpServers` field as the supported ownership boundary for plugin-declared MCP transports?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but this creates a permanent external plugin API and ownership model that requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve `mcpServers`
options.body: Adopt the manifest field as the canonical plugin declaration contract with the documented user-override and disable behavior.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Ship generic MCP Apps hosting through existing MCP configuration while removing the native-plugin manifest field.

recommendation.title: Approve `mcpServers`
recommendation.body: Adopt the manifest field as the canonical plugin declaration contract with the documented user-override and disable behavior.
